research_notes: Seek US institute appointment/CV/annual-report records for remuneration and hours, original employer identity and exact dates; resolve early career and 2000–2002 interval including study/work overlap before declaring complete coverage.

2026-09-29 initial research checked APH/frozen chronology, personal and party biographies, EPI institutional status, Johns Hopkins historical institutional material and 2007 labour-history conference contributor biography. Jess/Jessica Walsh plus EPI/JHU/year/full-time searches found many namesakes and no reliable individual hours record.

The official employer is Johns Hopkins University's Institute for Policy Studies. Secondary pages that link to the unrelated Washington think tank were not accepted as employer identification. Historical union name LHMU is evidenced in the conference proceedings; later United Voice/United Workers Union naming is not an extra job.

First-speech and Melbourne thesis catalogue links identified through reference listings did not return retrievable content; no unseen statements or thesis dates were used. Search snippets relating to an honorary university fellowship describe the next contributor, Fay Woodhouse, and were rejected for Walsh.

Known excluded jobs are not proof there was no countable earlier or concurrent work. Headline values remain null, not zero; no year-range sum or full-time assumption. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; retain unresolved status and advance initial national pass.

2026-10-02 follow-up: contemporary Johns Hopkins magazine supplies previously unrecorded2000 visiting-scholar affiliation; preserve official1998–99 fellowship without silently extending salary or resolving EPI overlap. EPI2002 acknowledgments corroborate research participation, not ongoing appointment. First speech now retrieved through Hansard mirror; decade in universities/policy centres is not a decade of paid full-time work. Melbourne thesis catalogue link returned restricted-URL error; secondary2002 completion year not adopted without primary catalogue/thesis. Early-work,full-time and2000–02 targeted searches yielded many namesakes and no hours evidence. Next: visiting-scholar terms and dated fellowship records, doctoral title page and pre1998 employment. No totals calculated.
